items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the rotated admissible triangle with the cone triangle of the rotated differential (statement lines 4166-4180). The proof (lines 4182-4254) is a hands-on computation in the differential graded category: the comparison maps are built from the splittings, their closedness follows from the delta[-1] identities of lemma-get-triangle with an explicit telescoping differential computation, and the two composition expansions collapse to the identity through the same identities. H2: every identity is displayed and verified in the span, and the result is the engine behind the rotation axiom verifications elsewhere in the chapter.
